ward.summary: Ward C used ₹8.0 lakh of its ₹9.0 lakh budget, 89%, staying within budget across 20 jobs. Repairs redone within 30 days were 40%, against 29% expected for similar work, which the data places in line with expectations; ₹2.5 lakh went to repairs that failed. On-time completion was 65% versus 62% expected. Two jobs are listed for review, and five jobs worth ₹1.8 lakh were paid on roads under warranty. Nine open issues would cost ₹2.6 lakh, led by manhole covers on Kalbadevi Road and Princess Street and waterlogging on Princess Street. The remaining ₹1.0 lakh covers only five of the nine.
